about_the_game:
Add the powerful M.1903 Rifle and M1A1 Gov. submachine gun to your armoury.

The M.1903 Rifle was the sniper rifle of choice for allied troops during the Allied Invasion of Europe. Sporting incredible range and muzzle velocity, this is a deadly addition to any sniper’s arsenal.

The iconic M1A1 Gov. submachine gun delivers lethal .45ACP rounds. But you will need to get up close and personal as the SMG’s lethality is balanced by its heavy weight and limited iron sight visibility.

New Character Skins

Much like Sniper Elite series hero Karl Fairburne, the Field Jacket is far above what would be considered standard military issue. Designed with a more casual fit to make those long nights stalking enemy targets more comfortable, it retains all of the tactical requirement any elite sniper would need to complete their mission, without compromising style.

As fans of the Sniper Elite series will know, Karl Fairburne is an extremely covert operations agent, and a deadly sniper. He is highly valued by both British and American intelligence for his wide-ranging abilities in ‘irregular warfare’, including (but not limited to) sabotage, asset recovery, and assassination.

The Fairburne’s Armoury Weapons and Skins Pack contains:

• M1A1 Gov. Submachine Gun

• M.1903 Rifle

• Field Jacket Character Skin

• Lieutenant Karl Fairburne Character Skin
